what: fat/universal Mach-O (x86_64 + arm64) assembled from the two thin rows by tools/macho_fat.py (no lipo on the host); slices are byte-identical to the thin rows
toolchain: go version go1.27.0 windows/amd64; fat header by fixtures/bench/tools/macho_fat.py
commands: GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' -o benchgo .
GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' -o benchgo .
stripped_how: -ldflags '-s -w' removes the symbol table and DWARF (pclntab remains, as in every Go binary); each slice is the stripped thin build
